A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have presented a simple, yet effective unsupervised deep learning approach for joint mining of features and labels, and demonstrated the efficacy of the approach on two challenging computer vision tasks: large-scale medical image categorization and unsupervised scene recognition.

our proposed unsupervised deep learning approach can be used for large-scale radiology image categorization and scene recognition, and can be easily extended to other applications where annotations are extremely difficult to obtain.
